        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        # Initial convolutional layer
        self.initial_conv = Conv2D(
            filters=16,
            kernel_size=(3, 3),
            strides=(1, 1),
            padding='same',
            activation=None
        )

        # Batch normalization and ReLU for initial path
        self.bn1 = BatchNormalization(axis=-1)
        self.relu1 = ReLU()

        self.conv1 = Conv2D(
            filters=16,
            kernel_size=(3, 3),
            strides=(1, 1),
            padding='same',
            activation=None
        )
        self.bn2 = BatchNormalization(axis=-1)
        self.relu2 = ReLU()

        self.conv2 = Conv2D(
            filters=16,
            kernel_size=(3, 3),
            strides=(1, 1),
            padding='same',
            activation=None
        )
        self.bn3 = BatchNormalization(axis=-1)
        self.relu3 = ReLU()

        # Branch convolutional layer
        self.branch_conv = Conv2D(
            filters=16,
            kernel_size=(3, 3),
            strides=(1, 1),
            padding='same',
            activation=None
